up: Retrieve exact activity values and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4513217. Start by filtering the assays table where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513217'. Join to the activities table on assay_id. Filter activities to only include exact values where standard_relation = '=' and standard_value IS NOT NULL. Join to compound_structures on molregno to get canonical_smiles. Also join molecule_dictionary on molregno to include compound identifiers and names. Return columns: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, and compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513217' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
